profile.summary:
Highly skilled Senior Physical Security and Information Systems Professional with 13 years + years. Management skills combined with great customer service, complimented with solid technical acumen and drive to meet organizational mission objectives, maximize growth and profitability. Ability to thrive in fast-paced and challenging environments. Seeking to join an organization that values professional development, growth, and team focused culture.

My Top Three Strengths:
Conflict Solutions 
Management expertise 
Active Listening 

Actively seeking connection with like minded tech professional and ecision makers

Sec+
Microsoft Security Compliance and Identity Fundamentals
Incident Management Response: Preventing Business Email Attacks

positions.title: Armed Protective Service officer
positions.description:
•	Observing and reporting daily activities and incidents at Internal Revenue Service office and Social Security Administration providing security and safety of client property, visitors and personnel within facility.
•	Preserves order and enforce regulations and directives for the location, controlling access to the facility through the required need to know procedures.
•	Monitors closed circuit television (CCTV) to entry and exit ways, preventing unapproved or unlawful entry within the building, detaining persons attempting to gain unauthorized access and reporting any significant events.
•	Conducts daily patrols in assigned area on foot or in vehicle, checks for hazardous conditions or security violations, protecting evidence or preparing logs or reports upon request.
•	Processing visitors by verifying identification, enforcing property rules and regulations, contacting agency sponsors or escorts, issuing visitor passes, entering and maintaining data within automated visitor database.
•	Provides requested information and directions to visitors and facility clients, ensuring a courteous atmosphere and exceptional customer service.
.

positions.title: Segeant Correctional Officer
positions.description:
•	Supervised ten correctional officers, maintaining order and discipline within the institution, enforcing facility regulations.
•	Monitored activities and work assignments of inmates, conducting regular routine inspections and identifying any discrepancies within the institution.
•	Oversaw alleged investigations from rule violations, inmate infractions, resolving day to day difficulties with conflict resolution services. 
•	Performed daily equipment checks for required weapons and returned defective items for repair, enforcing a secured institution.
•	Created and revised over ## Work Operating Procedures and Instructions for section memorandums, security procedures and daily operational guides assisting subordinates to remain compliant within Homeland Security and correctional facility requirements.

positions.title: Insurance Agent
positions.description:
•	Primary Inspector support for the lower region in Georgia conducting regular facility inspections, ensuring zero discrepancies within company policies.
•	Managed daily requirements and analyzed insurance premiums establishing payment means to assist clients. 
•	Utilized Policyholder Call Management expertise to describe policy features, collected, analyzed and gathered results for official reports, promotional sales and confirmed proper insurance plans per the customer.
•	Provided customer service support for incoming and follow up calls for initial policy fulfillment, demonstrated effective and efficient use of insurance software and necessary requirements for medical examinations and completion of documentation.
•	Worked alongside Underwriter to ensure submission of forms were done properly to obtain binder coverage for customers, preventing any delays within their insurance policies.
positions.insights: Property and Casualty Insurance, Customer Service and +7 skills
